snippet.title: Defenders of Cinderkeep Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Emberforged Studios is excited to announce our upcoming incremental auto-battler, Defenders of Cinderkeep!

Our steam page is still pending approval but you can connect with us on Discord: https://discord.gg/qvAt9SeVs

Check out the demo ahead of time on Itch.IO: https://emberforgedstudios.itch.io/defenders-of-cinderkeep-demo
